meta.refined: Values are the app's Tailwind values; usage is the refined direction agreed in October 2026 (one action colour, status colours for status only, a light theme added, brand-hover darkened for contrast).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (slate-950 in the app).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar, menus and modals.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Inside text fields and selects, set into a surface-raised card.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover, secondary button fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers and table rules: separation only, never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes; at least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures, on surface, surface-raised and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card subtitles, table cells that are not the main value; on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, timestamps, the small print under buttons; on surface and surface-raised (the app overrides Tailwind's slate-500 to #74839a for this).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one action colour: the primary button, the selected tab, the active nav item's marker. Never decoration, never a status.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover and press. (The app lightens to blue-500 on hover, which leaves white text at 3.7:1; the refined system darkens instead.)

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-hover fill.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links and the active nav label, as text on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the active nav item and a selected row, behind brand-text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px off the element; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status only: ex-employee access, overdue, failed. As text on surface-raised and danger-soft, always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill (delete, revoke all), with on-brand text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a danger badge or banner, behind danger text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status only: needs review, renewal soon, no owner. Text on surface-raised and warning-soft, with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning badge, behind warning text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status only: active, reviewed, saved. Text on surface-raised and success-soft, with a word or icon; never told apart from danger by colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success badge, behind success text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a modal, with a backdrop blur (bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur in the app).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The landing hero headline only; two lines at most.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one headline number of a stat tile (monthly spend, savings).

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Page title in the app's top bar and public page h1.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Déposez un export bancaire. Obtenez chaque abonnement logiciel récurrent.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 3 accès encore actifs pour des personnes parties.
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, card bodies, buttons, inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, small print, badge labels, timestamps.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a stat or a table column, in ink-subtle.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and small-button horizontal padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding, gap between cards on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (p-5 in the app).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between landing-page sections.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges that are not pills, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects (rounded-xl in the app).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and modals (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards: borders do the work, this barely lifts them.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and menus only. No coloured glows anywhere.
